Protocol: `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Executed sequentially (no subagent tool in this runner).

- framework: `fb82f9b180bcc6af04ce8d36153fd52d2eb6845c`, the tip of branch `claude/issue-23950-checklist-stale-clauses` at run time. Its product tree is `origin/main` `022c6e799`; the branch adds `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` only. Built with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75 tasks green).
- `.objectui-sha`: `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7`. `/_console` was served from `packages/console/dist`, built with `vite build` from an objectui checkout at exactly that commit. `os dev` mounted it, so its stamp matched the pin. `main` has since moved the pin to `f8267df9` (#23973); see the clause 5 and clause 0 notes for what that changes.

- browser: playwright-core 1.63 on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, a fresh context per script restored from the state saved after a form sign-in, desktop viewport 1400x900, phone 390x844.

## Scope

Selector `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` resolves to 1 runnable item: `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` at revision 3, P2, surface browser. The item text was read at branch head `c4bf2ba4e`. No pin is declared, so every clause was driven by hand.

## Per-clause verdicts

| item | # | clause (short) | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 0 | icon mode still navigates; collapse persists | **fail** | collapse works: wrapper `data-state` collapsed, cookie `sidebar_state=false`, still collapsed after reload. In icon mode only two icons show. Capability Map's icon routes. The Page Authoring icon does NOT: the invisible Workspace group label covers its lower half. A ref-targeted click is refused by Playwright, which names the intercepting element (the `data-sidebar="group-label"` button, opacity 0). A click at the icon's centre lands on that button and leaves the URL unchanged. Reproduced on two fresh loads (rule below) |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 1 | pin/unpin persists | pass | the row menu's Add to favorites on Projects, Tasks and Accounts gives a Favorites section of [Projects, Tasks, Accounts], identical after reload; Remove from favorites on Accounts, then reload, gives [Tasks, Projects] |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 2 | pinned order: drag, keyboard, Escape, reload | pass | 0 grips or sortable elements at rest. Pointer drag of Accounts above Projects (12 intermediate moves; drop indicator seen) gives [Accounts, Projects, Tasks]. Keyboard on Tasks (Space, ArrowUp, Space) gives [Accounts, Tasks, Projects]. Space, ArrowUp, Escape on Projects leaves it unchanged. After reload the order equals the pre-reload order. Control: each pinned link carries `cursor-grab` and `aria-describedby="nav-pinned"` |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 3 | favorite star/unstar persists | pass | a showcase_account record's More actions, Add to favorites: Favorites shows Fabrikam, still there after reload; Remove from favorites, then reload: gone |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 4 | Recents rail survives reload | pass | after visiting Contacts, Invoices, the Delivery Operations dashboard and Accounts, then reloading, the opened Recent section lists Accounts, Delivery Operations, Invoices, Contacts, Fabrikam (top 5) |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 5 | header crumbs follow the route (re-pointed by #23950) | pass | after the app pill (Showcase) and its PREVIEW chip, at 1400px. Report `…/report/showcase_hours_by_status`: one crumb, `Hours by Status (Summary)`, which is the report's metadata label and its page heading; no Reports type crumb. `…/system/settings`: `System`, `Settings`. A showcase_account record (Fabrikam): no separator and no crumb, while the page heading reads Fabrikam. 0 links after the chip on all three. Each reload reads identically |
| platform-core.shell-nav-personalization | 6 | authored menu not user-reorderable | pass | desktop with all groups expanded: 0 `aria-roledescription="sortable"`; of 49 menu links outside Favorites, 0 carry `aria-describedby="nav-pinned"` and 0 carry `cursor-grab` (control: the pinned links carry both); every level's order equals the app's authored order (by `order`, ties in array order); with `objectui-nav-order-showcase_app` planted with every level reversed and the page reloaded, the order is unchanged; phone 390px: 0 sortable, 0 describedby, 0 grab, and no Favorites section |

## Reproduction rule: clause 0 fail

1. Boot the stock showcase (any port), sign in at `/_console/login` as the seeded admin with a desktop viewport (1400x900), and open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map`.
2. Collapse the sidebar with the header's `Toggle sidebar` button. The sidebar wrapper reads `data-state="collapsed"` and `data-collapsible="icon"`.
3. Read the two visible icons with the sidebar's link selector. The Page Authoring link (`a[href$="/page/showcase_start_here"]`) spans y 108 to 140. The Workspace group label (`button[data-sidebar="group-label"]`, opacity 0, pointer-events auto) spans y 124 to 156: icon mode gives it a negative top margin, so it sits over the preceding item.
4. `document.elementFromPoint` at the Page Authoring link's centre returns the Workspace label button. Down the icon's vertical axis, 2 of 5 sampled points hit the link and 3 hit the label.
5. Click the Page Authoring icon at its centre. Expected: the route changes to `…/page/showcase_start_here`. Actual: the URL stays on `…/page/showcase_capability_map`. A ref-targeted Playwright `click()` on the link is refused, because the group-label button intercepts pointer events.
6. Control: the Capability Map icon, which no label covers, routes on a centre click.

Mechanism: objectui `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` `SidebarGroupLabel` takes `group-data-[state=collapsed]:group-data-[collapsible=icon]:-mt-8` and `…:opacity-0`, with no `pointer-events-none`. The navigation renders a collapsible group's label as a button through `asChild`, so the transparent label stays clickable over the last item above it. The same class string is at the run's pin `daeb77fc`, at the new pin `f8267df9`, and at objectui `main` `9d857c998`.

Automation self-check (RUNNER rule 2), against the item's traps:
- hydration-race: two fresh loads gave identical rectangles after a settle.
- shared-browser-tab: own port, DB and browser context.
- stale-console-bundle: the console was built at the pin, and the class is unchanged at the new pin and at objectui `main`.
- automation-input: the ref-targeted click was refused by the actionability check, which names the interceptor, and `elementFromPoint` agrees.

## Derived item verdict

`platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` r3: **fail** (6 pass, 1 fail of 7 clauses). The fail is clause 0, a product defect in the console. It is not one of the six clauses #23950 re-points; clause 5, the one #23950 re-points, passes. The extraction (RUNNER extraction obligation) is handed to the dispatching seat. This runner files no card.

Clause 5 against the moved pin: objectui `AppHeader.tsx` at `f8267df9` adds the product mark and a rule before the app pill (objectui#12605). It draws the same crumbs after the PREVIEW chip (`extraSegments` for report and `system/*`, none for an object route, plain text). Revision 3 cites both pins.

Harness note, not scored: these scripts restore a saved browser state per script. A context restored with a stale `objectui-favorites` localStorage cache wrote favorites back, and Accounts reappeared among the pins after clause 1 had unpinned it. That is this harness replaying an old cache. Clause 1 was scored in the sequence that did not replay one.

Timing: about 7 minutes of legs. The console bundle was already built; a cold `vite build` at the pin measured 1m44s.

Checklist-accuracy findings, if any, close out on the wave anchor #23878.
